41inline void compute_rhs_chi(const BSSNGridSoA<T> &G, Field3D<T> &rhs_chi, size_t padding = 4) {
42 const T ko_sigma = T(0.1);
43 size_t I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1;
44 G.domain_bounds(I0, I1, J0, J1, K0, K1);
45
46 std::fill(rhs_chi.ptr(), rhs_chi.ptr() + G.chi.st.nx_tot * G.chi.st.ny_tot * G.chi.st.nz_tot,
47 T(0));
48
49 const size_t i0 = clamped_lower(I0, padding, I1);
50 const size_t j0 = clamped_lower(J0, padding, J1);
51 const size_t k0 = clamped_lower(K0, padding, K1);
52 const size_t i1 = clamped_upper(I1, padding, I0);
53 const size_t j1 = clamped_upper(J1, padding, J0);
54 const size_t k1 = clamped_upper(K1, padding, K0);
55
56 if (i0 >= i1 || j0 >= j1 || k0 >= k1)
57 return;
58
59#pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
60 for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i) {
61 for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) {
62 for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {
63 const size_t id = G.chi.idx(i, j, k);
64 const T chi = G.chi.ptr()[id];
65 const T alpha = G.alpha.ptr()[id];
66 const T K = G.K.ptr()[id];
67 const T beta_x = G.beta[0].ptr()[id];
68 const T beta_y = G.beta[1].ptr()[id];
69 const T beta_z = G.beta[2].ptr()[id];
70 const T d_chi = beta_x * tensorium_RG::fd::Dx_upwind(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dx, beta_x) +
71 beta_y * tensorium_RG::fd::Dy_upwind(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dy, beta_y) +
72 beta_z * tensorium_RG::fd::Dz_upwind(G.chi, i, j, k, G.dz, beta_z);
73 const T div_beta = tensorium_RG::fd::Dx(G.beta[0], i, j, k, G.dx) +
74 tensorium_RG::fd::Dy(G.beta[1], i, j, k, G.dy) +
75 tensorium_RG::fd::Dz(G.beta[2], i, j, k, G.dz);
76 rhs_chi.ptr()[id] = d_chi + (T(2.0 / 3.0)) * chi * (alpha * K - div_beta) +
77 T(tensorium_RG::fd::KO6(G.chi, i, j, k, ko_sigma));
78 }
79 }
80 }
